result.title: EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs
result.summary: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

AI.brief_summary: EviGraph 面向公共服务推荐，用语言代理把决策所需的关键要求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据，再由确定性检查器判断推荐是否被支持，并在双语香港基准上验证区分「关键要求」与「可不确定信息」能减少不必要的弃答。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时必须有证据支持、何时可保持未决」的判定与验证反而撤回正确推荐的负结果，可能启发 LVR 中 STOP 决策与证据筛选的价值权衡，可供核查但不涉及多模态 latent 状态。
